summary: Fetch immutable new-project release evidence during adoption

delivery.outcome: Goal verifies immutable new-project annotated-tag evidence before executing a production adoption generator
nonGoals: No new runtime dependency, version bump or package publication
No weakening of exact-SHA checkout or generator exit-code forwarding
No production trust claim for unpublished candidate tests

architecture.decision: Extend Goal's existing acquisition boundary with version-matched annotated-tag verification before dispatching the pinned generator
architecture.rollback: Revert the tag verifier and candidate option; exact-SHA checkout remains but no longer proves immutable tag publication

validation.evidence: untagged, lightweight and mismatched release-tag fixtures fail before generator execution
annotated exact tag fixture preserves adoption, check and upgrade forwarding
explicit candidate flag is forwarded while normal mode remains strict
focused/full tests, scoped lint, governance and package build pass
